digest.component_or_area: project guidance and CI workflow documentation
propositions: Intermittently failing tests are bugs to root-cause using /rebar-debug, not transient faults to retry until they pass.
Flaky CI pipelines slow development, waste tokens, and erode trust in CI as a regression oracle; the project must debug nondeterministic tests rather than recheckable them.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md currently contradict by offering recheck for failures that 'look transient/flaky' without distinguishing environmental faults from test nondeterminism.
The recheck command must be reserved for provably environmental faults (TLS cert flakes, missing CI dispatch, runner outages) with stated reasoning in the comment.

Documentation must be reconciled so AGENTS.md states the rule with rationale, CONTRIBUTING.md §6 splits environmental from test cases, and both point to a single authoritative source instead of restating it.
